title: Negation-aware skill trigger scorer: Not-for clauses stop counting as evidence

AC1.note: stripExclusionClauses (scout.ts) removes Not-for/Never/Do-not-use-for/Does-not/Use-X-instead/(not X)/(see X) clauses from entry text before scoring; excluded tokens dropped only, not negative-weighted (conservative choice, journal T5 entry). PR #725 merged as b722dc52.

AC2.note: scoutSkill/nearestSkills reuse entryLexicalTokens (round 1) and strip their own description-shaped query too (round 1 fix); AC2 test in scout.test.ts demonstrates quality/pr no longer scores a perfect 1.0 for pr-issue-documenter's topic. PR #725.

AC3.note: No model call added; the merged PR #725 diff confirms src/harness/routing/star-star and src/harness/decision/star-star untouched (verified both review rounds).

AC4.note: nodejs-testing/nodejs-implementation real bundled example test; full-catalog regression via checkSkillSelectedLeaveOneOut (non-circular grader), ratchet test <=155/642 after #719 merge re-measurement. scout.test.ts.

AC5.note: Honest before/after measured twice (pre- and post-#719-merge): TP/FP totals and per-skill diffs recorded in journal with root-cause investigation for every regression; 4 restored via honest description edits, 4 left as documented honest losses. No evals.json/SKILL.md edited to chase a number.

AC6.note: checkStablePackGate re-run for go and python (the only stable packs) against the merged 110-skill catalog: both pass. Journal has the direct call output.

AC7.note: docs/docs/guides/write-a-rubric-scenario.md updated with the recognized exclusion-clause forms, consumer list, and query-side conditionality; corrected twice per review rounds 1 and 2.
